title: PicChat
description: This mod allows you to send gifs and images to chat!
body:
## Now you can send photos and gifs directly to the chat!

This mod allows you to send gifs and images via links using commands.

List of commands:

- .img <url>
- .gif <url>
- .pic img/gif <url>

## Pay attention!
Images and gifs will be visible only to those players who installed this mod and to themselves as well.

The gif limit is the first 80 frames.


This is our first mod and its first version, there may be bugs and poor support for other mods, but we will fix it

## Let us know on Discord if you find a bug or have a suggestion!
